privacy.spot-volume-rank.definition: Rank of Solana DEX spot volume against centralized exchanges for the latest reported week.
privacy.spot-volume-rank.note: Week ending Oct 23, 2026: $12.63B, 14th straight week behind only Binance. Secondary source; no primary monthly comparison was found, so the label says weekly.

privacy.rwa-growth-12m.definition: Year-over-year multiple of tokenized real-world asset value on Solana.
privacy.rwa-growth-12m.note: No public year-ago RWA.xyz baseline was found and its API needs a token; the current level is rwa.distributed-value ($5.3B on 2026-10-30), which replaces the stale $4.3B.

privacy.xstocks-solana-share.definition: Share of xStocks tokenized equity supply held on Solana.
privacy.xstocks-solana-share.note: Searches found only volume and DeFi-deposit shares (for example 97% of tokenized-equity spot volume), not a by-chain holdings split; RWA.xyz needs an API token.

privacy.gsib-count.definition: Global systemically important banks building on Solana.
privacy.gsib-count.note: A curated count of named institutions; no single public source lists all seven.

privacy.confidential-balances-audits.definition: Security audits covering confidential balances (Token-2022 confidential transfers and ZK ElGamal proofs).
privacy.confidential-balances-audits.note: github.com/anza-xyz/security-audits lists 17 Token-2022 audits by 11 firms, but not all cover confidential transfers, so the 15-by-10 split could not be checked.

privacy.confidential-transfer-fee.definition: Network fees to complete one confidential transfer.
privacy.confidential-transfer-fee.note: A confidential transfer spans several proof transactions, so network.average-fee-30d is a different measure; no published per-transfer cost was found.
